scope: Six decoded frame pairs from one existing Test3 technical comparison; not a whole-video subject suitability score

visual_review.reviewer: Codex visual inspection of the six actual matched frame pairs

observations.finding: Interview guest is pushed against the left border; part of the head/body is outside the crop. Browser chrome and taskbar remain.
Full source shows two seated people talking. The left guest is absent from the cropped output, while the interviewer on the right remains.
Full source shows a white-shirt speaker at left. The crop excludes that speaker and keeps the sign and people on the right.
Outdoor vlogger is against the left border. Existing scrolling comments and original subtitles remain.

visual_review.conclusion: Exact fixed-center crop is technically reproducible, but this real screen recording is not suitable for automatic publishing with this framing. It loses speaking subjects/context in sampled scenes.
visual_review.limitation: Six frames are evidence of specific failures; they do not measure whole-video subject retention or generic suitability.
visual_review.recommended_default_for_this_source: Keep the landscape export. If portrait is required, prefer a whole-picture fit/pad layout or explicitly preview and confirm each crop; neither adaptive crop nor fit/pad mode has been added here.
